tasks.title: Copy Command Center chat webhook URL (desktop)
tasks.subtitle: Phone can’t open “When a webhook fires” — do this on Mac/PC for instant chat wake
steps: On a computer, open the Grok Bot app (not Google/Safari search — grokbot:// links are in-app only)
Open Chief of Staff chat → click the name in the header → Routines → Command Center chat
Click When a webhook fires
Copy Webhook URL — must start with https:// and must NOT be huggingface.co, github.io, or grokbot://
Tell Chief of Staff you have it (or paste into the secure field when asked) so it can be set as GROK_WEBHOOK_URL on the Space
Until then: hard-refresh https://simzy420.github.io/command-center/ and use Chat → Chief of Staff (replies via 5-minute poll backup)
